# opnsense_caddy_access_list (Resource)

Caddy access lists (**Services ▸ Caddy Web Server ▸ Reverse Proxy ▸ Access**, plugin `os-caddy`), used by domains, subdomains and handlers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_caddy_access_list" "lan" {
  name       = "lan"
  client_ips = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_ips` (Set of String) Enter the client IP addresses or networks for this access list. Accepts multiple IPv4/IPv6 addresses or networks.
- `name` (String) Enter a name for this access list.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Enter a description for this access list. Defaults to ``.
- `http_response_code` (Number) Set a custom HTTP response code that should be returned to the requesting client when the access list does not match. If empty, the connection is aborted with no response. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `http_response_message` (String) Set a custom HTTP response message in addition to the HTTP response code. If empty, the default HTTP response message for the chosen HTTP response code will be used. Defaults to ``.
- `invert` (Boolean) If checked, the access list logic will be inverted (i.e., the listed IPs will be blocked instead of allowed). Defaults to `false`.
- `request_matcher` (String) Set the request matcher that will be applied to this access list. One of `client_ip`, `remote_ip`. Defaults to `client_ip`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Caddy access list.
